note: Divergences between the committed Cloud Armor capture and what edge.ts declares that are known and recorded. The GCP edge is being wound down, so closing them means changing a deployed policy on its way out, which is a deliberate decision rather than routine remediation. Read alongside CLOUD-ARMOR-BASELINE.md's 'Machine-checked parity' section, which explains why they are recorded rather than left as a permanently red check. Each entry matches one priority, one field and one exact observed value: there is no wildcard form, so an entry cannot grow to cover a divergence nobody decided to accept. An entry whose divergence stops happening fails the check until it is deleted, so this list shrinks visibly as remediation lands and never silently re-accepts a fixed problem.

accepted.reason: The captured sqli rule carries preview: it records a match rather than acting on it, while edge.ts declares the rule enforcing. See CLOUD-ARMOR-BASELINE.md, 'The capture and the code diverge on eight fields'.
